title: Xdrip i mi band 4
symptom: After connecting xDrip with MiaoMiao 2, the user tried to connect xDrip with Mi Band 4. xDrip finds the band and connects, but there are no readings on the band, only occasional alarms that match phone alarms.
evidence_quote: Povezali smo xdrip i miao miao 2,sve radi ok,kad smo pokusali da xdrip povezemo sa mi band 4 nismo uspjeli.Xdrip ga pronadje,povezano sve ali na mi band nema ocitavanja,samo se javi alarm ponekad
